text:
Priya: Quick sync — SilkEdge (edge SoC) EAP kickoff. NDA in place (signed by partner/legal). They gave us two devkits next week. Main asks: 1) run our perf + latency suites, 2) validate quant paths, 3) check cold-start KV cache behavior.
Samir: I'll coordinate hardware intake. Need serial numbers and shipping ETA. Also confirm whether devkits expose the JTAG console or just ssh.
Alex: I'll own the runtime image build and kernel params. Partner sent kernel flags: `silk.noprefetch=1 silk.opt_batch=2`. We should test with and without those.
Denise: I'll curate the eval prompts and the small labeled QA set for quality gating. Propose we use eval/mini-2k and a couple of customer-like prompts (conversational + instruction).
Priya: Models for initial pass: redwood/llama-13b-q4 and redwood/pythia-3b-fp. Keep the 13b quant as the primary production slice.
Samir: Logistics: request sent to ops for 3 devkits (two for parallel runs, one spare). Ops ticket #5048. ETA Wed next week. I'll post tracking.
Alex: Build note: I'll push `redwood-runtime:silkedge-2026-01` to our internal registry. Need partner's signed firmware blob by Monday. Also we should pin cuda/cu-like equivalents if they expose an acceleration lib.
Denise: QA thresholds proposal: - perplexity delta <= 3% vs baseline, - p95 latency <= 180ms for 13B-q4, - token throughput >= 100 tok/s at batch=4. If failure -> open regression and block any marketplace claims.
Priya: Partner constraint: embargo until both sides review results and an integration checklist completes. They want a joint marketplace tile but only after security review + on-device telemetry opt-in.
Alex: Example bench invocation for reproducibility:
```
./bin/bench --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 \
  --suite perf,latency --batch 4 \
  --devkit /dev/silk0 --output /tmp/silk_run1.json
```
Will tag results: silkedge-eap-2026-01.
Samir: I'll create an S3 prefix s3://redwood-eap/silkedge/runs/ and add a manifest. Access: partner gets read-only to a restricted bucket path per NDA.
Denise: We'll run an A/B: quantized vs fp baseline on identical prompts to catch hallucination/regression. I'll prepare a short rubric for human eval (clarity, factuality, safety).
Priya: Communication plan: internal readout after run#1, then partner review. If both OK, we draft marketplace listing + joint blog timing. Tentative window: mid-Dec but dependent on compliance.
build-bot: CI job queued: eap/silkedge/5048 -> build 2217. Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/2217
Alex: Can we add automated comparison artifacts to the harness? JSON diffs + summary chart would be ideal. Jordan from benchmarks can we loop him in? (he's OOO til Friday).
Priya: Action items recap: Samir -> ops ticket & tracking (#5048), Alex -> runtime image + push, Denise -> eval set + rubric, Priya -> partner readout invite and integration checklist doc. We will checkpoint daily in this thread.
Samir: Noted. Will post shipping numbers when available.
Denise: Uploading eval manifest to s3 path by EOD.
Alex: Will open PR with CI job + bench wrapper tomorrow AM.
Priya: Thanks team. Keep everything internal until partner sign-off. Quick standup tomorrow 9:30am PT in #partnerships? :clock9:
